outputPath.description: Folder, relative to the workspace root, receiving the package; unset, the target packs nothing

timestampAuthority.description: Timestamp server ZXPSignCmd -tsa signs against, so a CEP package outlives its certificate

title: Package
description: Packs the Adobe UXP plugin or CEP extension the project's other builds wrote, else its source folder: a .ccx zip for a manifest.json, a ZXPSignCmd-signed .zxp for a CSXS/manifest.xml
